C08-M05-L07-F1.title: The eight sections of a defensible case record
C08-M05-L07-F1.caption: What each section of a case record holds and which reader depends on it most.
C08-M05-L07-F1.alt: Table with columns Section, What it records and Main reader. Header: case ID, title, severity, status, owner, UTC open and close; read by the queue and the SOC lead. Summary: three to five plain sentences, kept current; read by the manager and the next analyst. Entities: hosts, users, IPs, domains, hashes with roles; read by the next analyst, who pivots on them. Timeline (UTC): time, source, event, why it matters, facts only; read by the incident handler. Analysis: hypotheses, confidence, what was ruled out; read by the next analyst and reviewer. Actions: what was done, by whom, approved by whom, when; read by the incident lead and auditor. Evidence: item, location, SHA-256, method, custody; read by the auditor. Disposition plus next steps: label, one-line reason, owned next actions; read by everyone, in violet like Analysis.
rows: case ID, title, severity, status, owner, UTC open/close
hosts, users, IPs, domains, hashes + role
time, source, event, why it matters: facts only
hypotheses, confidence, what was ruled out
what, who did it, who approved, when
label, one-line reason, owned next actions
C08-M05-L07-F1.note: Facts go in the timeline, reasoning in the analysis, proof in the evidence list; the disposition must follow from all three.

C08-M05-L07-F2.title: Fact or inference: the Banyan alerts written both ways
C08-M05-L07-F2.caption: Observations from the dataset beside the conclusions an analyst draws from them, each with a confidence level.
C08-M05-L07-F2.alt: Two columns separated by vs. Left, green, Observed fact (cite the source): 06:14:00Z sysmon: WINWORD.EXE started hidden encoded PowerShell; 06:17-07:42Z proxy: 18 requests of 220 bytes, mean gap 300 s; 06:46:00Z vpn: gopal success from 203.0.113.66 after 8-account spray; 08:12:00Z proxy: bytes_out 48200000 to files-share-drop.example; no event links the VPN session to WS-104. Right, violet, Inference (state confidence): macro document executed code, high; command-and-control beaconing, high; gopal credential compromised, high, method unknown; probable exfiltration, medium, content unknown; VPN and phishing linked, hypothesis, low.

items: 06:14:00Z sysmon: WINWORD.EXE started hidden, encoded PowerShell
06:17-07:42Z proxy: 18 requests, 220 bytes, mean gap 300 s

C08-M05-L07-F2.note: A fact can be re-run as a query; an inference can only be argued, so it must carry its confidence.
